title: CbamExtractionResult
description:
Nucleos -> Arbor. Structured fields out.

Every field is a DRAFT. Nothing here assigns a provenance tier: only a human action in Arbor's Review screen does that. Arbor writes these as ExtractedField rows and the reviewer decides.

document_class.description: What Nucleos decided the document actually is, which may differ from the document_type Arbor sent.

lines.description: Goods lines, when the document has them.

flags.description:
Nucleos's flag vocabulary, carried VERBATIM.

These strings — flagReason, repair_failed:*, arbiter_conflict:*, claude_value_not_evidenced_in_text and the rest — are the anti-hallucination signals a reviewer needs. Never summarise, translate, group or prettify them in transit. A reviewer deciding whether to accept a value needs to know that the arbiter had a conflict and which extractors disagreed, not that 'there was an issue'.

source_text.description: The exact verbatim text the value came from. Required for a reviewer to confirm anything; a field without it can only ever be Declared.

extractor.description: Nucleos's fine-grained extractor tag. Kept separate from Arbor's ExtractionMethod enum — see common.json EvidenceAtom.source.

flags.description: Per-field flags, verbatim. Same rule as the top-level flags array.

emissions_method.description: What the document declared, when it declared one. A draft like every other field — the selector decides the operative method at calculation time.
